mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about evaporation reflects a common misconception?

options.A: Evaporation occurs only on hot sunny days.
options.B: Evaporation can happen at any temperature, even below the boiling point.
options.C: Evaporation is the process where a liquid turns into a gas at its surface.
options.D: Evaporation speeds up when the surface area of water increases.

mcqs.answer: Evaporation occurs only on hot sunny days.
mcqs.explanation: Many students think evaporation needs high heat, but it can occur at any temperature; only the rate changes. Option A is the false statement, making it the misconception. Options B, C, and D correctly describe evaporation facts.

mcqs.question: Why does water vapour in the air form tiny droplets on the outside of a cold glass of water?

options.A: The cold surface lowers the kinetic energy of water molecules, causing them to change into liquid droplets.
options.B: The glass releases heat that evaporates the water vapour.
options.C: The air pressure increases near the glass, forcing the vapour to condense.
options.D: The glass absorbs water vapour and turns it directly into solid ice.

mcqs.answer: The cold surface lowers the kinetic energy of water molecules, causing them to change into liquid droplets.
mcqs.explanation: Condensation occurs when water vapour loses kinetic energy upon contacting a cooler surface, allowing molecules to come together and form liquid droplets. Options B, C, and D describe processes that do not cause condensation.

mcqs.question: Which statement best distinguishes water vapour present in the atmosphere from visible fog?

options.A: Water vapour is an invisible gas, whereas fog consists of tiny liquid droplets that scatter light.
options.B: Water vapour is liquid water suspended in air, while fog is solid ice crystals.
options.C: Water vapour can be seen as a mist, but fog is invisible.
options.D: Both water vapour and fog are the same; they differ only in temperature.

mcqs.answer: Water vapour is an invisible gas, whereas fog consists of tiny liquid droplets that scatter light.
mcqs.explanation: Water vapour is the gaseous phase of water and cannot be seen. Fog is made of microscopic liquid droplets that reflect and scatter light, making it visible. Options B, C, and D contain inaccurate descriptions of the two phenomena.

mcqs.learning_point: Factors affecting evaporation at an introductory level
mcqs.question: Which combination of factors will most increase the rate of evaporation of water from an open pan?

options.A: High temperature, large surface area, low humidity, and strong wind.
options.B: Low temperature, small surface area, high humidity, and no wind.
options.C: High temperature, small surface area, high humidity, and still air.
options.D: Low temperature, large surface area, low humidity, and strong wind.

mcqs.answer: High temperature, large surface area, low humidity, and strong wind.
mcqs.explanation: Evaporation speeds up with higher temperature (more kinetic energy), larger exposed surface, lower surrounding humidity (greater vapor pressure gradient), and stronger wind (removes saturated air). Option A includes all these favorable conditions. The other options contain one or more unfavorable factors that would reduce the evaporation rate.
